note: The minimal scored task set (P23). Five canonical tasks, each scored on five deterministic axes (routing, capabilities, modules, structure, emission); the 1.0 baseline per task is pinned by tests/test_scoreboard.py, so component-ablation (M5.12) can re-run these same tasks against a pruned configuration and compare on the same ground. The allowed/must values were taken from an actual classify+derive run on 2026-10-23, not written from memory (M0.4). A baseline change is a deliberate edit here, never a silent drift. P24 added the effect axis: every task declares its effect_metric (the machine-scorable metric for that task family) but stays unmeasured until a real run records a full {status: measured, score, judge, measured_on} receipt; the effect score never enters the structural total. DELIBERATE BASELINE EDIT 2026-10-28 (P36): the lit-review must_modules moved M8 -> M5. The M8 came from a classification misfire -- bare 'review' fired the human-review collaboration cue on 'literature review' -- which P36 fixed together with a missing horizon cue ('week' now raises multi_session); the corrected derive enables M5 (multi-week work => self-evolution + durable memory) and disables M8 (solo work). The baseline follows the fixed engine, with the reason recorded here per M0.5. DELIBERATE COVERAGE WIDENING 2026-10-28 (P44): the P40 ablation found 28 of 38 capabilities unpinned by the must sets. Widened lit-review/kg-dh/deep-research with the four research-definitional disciplines their actual runs match (untrusted-content-discipline, context-budget-policy, resumable-memory, tool-use) and model-choice with untrusted-content-discipline, tool-use, reproducible-experiments (M4.17's selection discipline); unit-tests gains nothing (its two musts are already the definitional pair). Added two canonical tasks - proof-verification and bayesian-stats - so the domain-keyed capabilities (formal-verification, statistical-inference) have a task family to pin; their allowed/must values come from actual classify+derive runs on 2026-10-28. The scoreboard now pins 17 of 38 units; the remaining 21 are incidental at these seven families (recorded in review/ablation-baseline-2026-10.md section 5).

effect_axis.note: Structure and effect are different claims, so they are reported separately. effect_metric defines what a real run would measure per task; no score exists until one does (M0.4).
